Actor Bardem Urges UNICEF to Remove P!nk as Ambassador Over Palestine Stance

Spanish actor Javier Bardem has promoted an online petition on Instagram calling for the removal of US singer P!nk as a UNICEF ambassador. The petition, hosted on Change.org, has garnered over 150,000 signatures. Bardem's call is reportedly linked to P!nk's stance on Palestine.
